notes: All 788 physical subject rows across 24 sections are reconciled, with original Name/Team cells and 212 literal Rookie marks. The numeric-leading 92 FINEST caption is a section heading, not a card; its 44 numbered rows remain separate from Landmark Metal Series. All 228 Hobby/Breaker Delight odds categories retain literal values, including Base Common 6:1; the sheet states no ratio unit. Five exact card-specific guide/pull-report examples retain their published terms without numbering other subjects. Mixed Rookie Finest/Finest Freshman examples remain qualified without a family join. The May 22 official pull report explicitly states May 15 release, separate from product year 2025. Exhaustive parallel numbering remains unverified.
